_comment: Required visual roles and display states of the confirmed Q-D decisions (research/14 §3.3). Each item is verified by the checks that name it in tests/spec/runtime/*.json, or carries `unverified` with a reason and the risk. platforms: where the role applies (desktop = macOS for release purposes; Windows / Linux are not guaranteed until verified, research/14 §2.3). Mobile checks are emulated until step 10, so a mandatory mobile role stays below the release bar until a device PASS exists.

requirements.description: Ribbon background = Inkdrop sidebar background
Left and right dock bodies = Inkdrop note list background
Left and right dock tab strips = Inkdrop note list background
Centre tab strip = Inkdrop note list background
Inactive centre tabs paint nothing of their own, so they show the note-list tab strip
Active centre tab = Inkdrop editor background
View Header = Inkdrop editor background
Centre editor background = Inkdrop editor background
Status bar background = Inkdrop note list background
With the default Hidden frame the title bar is not displayed; the title-bar colour (note list) reaches the screen through the top tab strips
Hidden frame (macOS): the corner above the ribbon, under the window buttons (.workspace-ribbon.mod-primary::before), shows the title-bar colour (note list), continuous with the left dock's tab strip
Title bar = Inkdrop note list background where a frame style displays it

unverified.reason: The default Hidden frame does not display .titlebar. Displaying it needs another window-frame setting and a restart of the isolated instance, not automated yet (step 5 or 11).
unverified.risk: Users of a frame style that shows the title bar could see a colour other than the note list if a rule outranks --titlebar-background there.

requirements.description: Mobile left and right drawers = Inkdrop note list background
Phone navigation bar = Inkdrop note list background (floating and non-floating); tablets have none
Mobile drawer header shows the note list background

unverified.reason: The header paints no background of its own (transparent in the PoC measurement), so its visible colour is the drawer's; a Computed Style check cannot show that. Needs a pixel check on a device (step 10).
unverified.risk: A raised or blurred header layer on iOS / Android could change the visible colour.

requirements.description: Accent h/s/l = Inkdrop primary colour by default
An accent colour picked in Obsidian wins over the theme
Settings modal (a popout window in Obsidian 1.14.4) = Inkdrop preferences view and sidebar colours, active section = Inkdrop active sidebar item; translucent rules do not reach it
Translucent: the workspace tint is Inkdrop's acrylic page background (transparent), so .app-container shows the window material
Translucent: ribbon = Inkdrop sidebar acrylic

Translucent: the corner above the ribbon = Inkdrop note list acrylic, continuous with the tab strip (app.css forces it transparent); checked in Computed Style and in native captures (tests/visual/configs/top-left-corner.json)
Translucent: dock bodies = Inkdrop note list acrylic, painted on .workspace-leaf-content (the leaf itself is forced transparent by app.css)
Translucent: dock and centre tab strips = Inkdrop note list acrylic; inactive centre tabs show the strip
Translucent: centre editor, View Header and active tab = Inkdrop editor acrylic; the leaf content stays transparent
Translucent: status bar = Inkdrop note list acrylic
No acrylic override applies while body has is-fullscreen (the condition app.css uses); measured by adding the class, not by entering macOS full screen
Quick switcher = Inkdrop modal box colour, selected row = Inkdrop active selection-list colour, border = strong border; unchanged while translucent
In real macOS full screen Obsidian sets is-fullscreen and the window shows the opaque mapping

verifiedBy.method: Real macOS full screen of the isolated Obsidian window (Electron 43.7.7, translucency on) with the user's approval; computed styles before, during and after
verifiedBy.result: PASS on 2026-10-11 for Kanagawa Dragon: during full screen body has is-fullscreen and every surface shows the opaque Inkdrop colour; acrylic again after leaving. Solarized Dark was not put in full screen (the rules are shared; only the values differ)

requirements.description: Translucent, active window: native captures of each surface within dE2000 1.0 of Inkdrop's acrylic composite taken under the same conditions (research/14 工程 4)

verifiedBy.method: V-38: native captures of Inkdrop 6.1.5 (acrylic) and the isolated Obsidian 1.14.4 / Electron 43.7.7 (translucent), same session (about 10 s apart per pair), same geometry, backdrop and capture method; flat regions paired by Q-D1 (tests/visual/v38-compare.py)
verifiedBy.result: PASS on 2026-10-11: gray backdrop, active window, 14 of 14 pairs (both themes x ribbon, docks, vault profile, tab strips, editor) at dE2000 0.00

requirements.description: UI text = Inkdrop text colour, weak text = muted / disabled colours (SD base3-derived), error/success/warning = Inkdrop negative/positive/warning
Dividers: dock/editor, tab strips and status bar = Inkdrop note-list border; ribbon edge = Inkdrop sidebar border; general borders = Inkdrop border / strong / focused colours; also while translucent
File Explorer: item text = Inkdrop note-list title colour; open file = Inkdrop selected fill; 5 px left bar (Inkdrop active colour) only while the explorer has focus
Clickable icons = Inkdrop sidebar action colours; navigation headings = Inkdrop section colour
Page preview popover = Inkdrop popup colour, scoped to the popover (no other overlay changes)
Tooltip = Inkdrop tooltip colour; notice = Inkdrop notification colour
DOM menus = Inkdrop menu colour, row under the pointer = Inkdrop menu hover colour (macOS shows native OS menus by default, which no theme can style)
Buttons, dropdowns, inputs, checkbox mark, toggle (off lane, thumb) and scrollbars = Inkdrop control colours; accent-coloured states stay on the (user-overridable) accent
Tags = Inkdrop default tag colours, no accent-based hover
UI font = Inkdrop UI font stack (lint-quoted names resolve to the same fonts, V-36)
A user's interface font setting wins over the theme's UI font
Note text: editor (Source mode, Live Preview) = Inkdrop editor foreground, reading view and rendered blocks = Inkdrop preview / UI text colour (KD differs: no 90% alpha in the editor)
Headings: editor = --syntax-heading-N colours, reading view = preview heading colour (h6 muted) with Inkdrop's h1 (2 px) and h2 (1 px) rules
Bold and italic = Inkdrop strong / emphasis colours per view; strikethrough stays a line-through

Links: UI = Inkdrop --link-color, editor = --syntax-link-color (underlined), reading view = --mde-preview-link-color (underlined on hover only); internal and unresolved links take the same colour per view
Editor Markdown marks (#, **, backticks, fences, link brackets, URL parentheses, table pipes) = Inkdrop processing-instruction colour, URLs = --syntax-url-color (V-25)
Blockquote: editor = --md-blockquote-border-color bar (Live Preview), --syntax-quote-color italic text and mark; reading view = preview bar and muted upright text
List markers cycle Inkdrop's three marker colours by level, editor (--md-list-mark-*) and reading view (--mde-preview-list-marker-*)
Done tasks keep the text colour and are struck through; reading view strike-through colour = --mde-preview-task-list-checked-color
Rendered tables (reading view and Live Preview widget) = Inkdrop preview head text / head row / body rows / odd-row stripe / cell borders
Horizontal rule: rendered = Inkdrop's 0.25em preview bar; Source mode --- = --syntax-content-separator-color, bold
Inline code: editor = --md-inline-code background / border and monospace colour, reading view = preview inline code text / background / border
Code blocks (frame and background only, syntax colours are step 8): editor = --md-codeblock-*, reading view = --mde-preview-codeblock-* (KD/SD border from the base Tailwind blue-200, Q-D9)
Highlight (==text==) = Inkdrop mark text, background and 3 px underline per view, unblended
Callouts note / tip / important / warning / caution = Inkdrop GFM alert colours (SD important = the base purple, Q-D9) as a 0.25em left bar and title colour, no fill
Reading view footnotes = Inkdrop preview footnote text colour and 1 px border
Images: Live Preview = Inkdrop editor image backdrop colour, reading view = preview image background
Embedded notes render with the preview values in every view (Obsidian-only element, E36)
Keyboard keys = Inkdrop preview kbd text, background and border
The user's text and monospace font settings win (the theme sets neither)
Properties (Obsidian-only, E31) keep the UI mapping; no Inkdrop counterpart to compare with

unverified.reason: Inkdrop has no in-note property form, so there are no values to check against (06 E31)
unverified.risk: Property labels and inputs inherit the editor scope's text colour (KD: the editor foreground) and the UI borders; a mismatch with Inkdrop cannot exist, but their look is untested
